reviewFlags.issue: No fetched manufacturer, importer or retailer page gives the specs for PVHC4F-BK (3600W total, 4 zones, 1200W/1800W burners, 60 cm size, 220-240V). The only mentions are search snippets from Israeli retailers, and the Compshop listing returned HTTP 403. Check the specs against the manufacturer manual or the importer before publishing.

In search results, the 1200W/1800W burner split and the 490 mm cut-out appear for the sibling two-zone model PVHC2F-BK (outer 290 x 510 x 55 mm, niche 270 x 490 mm), not for PVHC4F-BK. The catalog's 56 x 49 cm cut-out and burner split may have been copied from that sibling. Verify them for the 4-zone model.

The Israeli importer is not named on any fetched page. A retailer lists 'אחריות יבואן' (importer warranty) without naming the importer. Proview International Holdings, the Hong Kong brand owner on Wikipedia, is reported to have stopped operating, so the current maker and Israeli distributor are unclear. Confirm who imports and supports this model.
